title: Onboard Solara-13B v1.0: metadata, perf profiles, and changelog automation
author: Priya Shah
description: Onboard Solara-13B v1.0 to the model registry with canonical metadata, performance profiles and add the model to changelog/release-notes automation. Motivation: Solara is a cuDNN-optimized 13B model that shows strong throughput/latency tradeoffs for short-chat and long-context workloads; customers requested availability in the hosted catalog and Dedicated tier. This PR includes: 1) models/solara-13b/meta.yaml with model manifest (architecture, tokenizer, recommended quantization tags, supported sequence lengths, export hashes). 2) perf_profiles/solara-13b.json containing latency/tps profiles measured across representative instance types (a100-80gb, h100-80gb, and t4) with percentile buckets and memory/kv-cache footprint estimates. 3) docs/models/solara-13b.md short landing doc with supported use-cases and known limitations. 4) scripts/changelog-gen.py updated to auto-include new model metadata into release notes via the changelog index; adds a metadata->release entry mapping. 5) tests/test_solara_perf.py basic perf regression sanity check used by CI. Checklist: - [x] Add canonical metadata and validate schema - [x] Attach perf profiles generated by benchmark-lab run (bench-id: bench-2025-09-29-solara) - [x] Add docs and usage notes - [x] Wire up changelog automation so the model appears in release notes on merge - [x] Unit tests and perf smoke tests pass Notes on decisions: quantization recommendations include int8-gguf and fp16 for Dedicated tiers; short-chat baseline uses 32-token prompt and 128-token generation target for latency numbers. Compatibility: no API surface changes. Release notes entry generated automatically when this PR was merged.
